alias_distinction.conclusion: The primary public gpt5_5 donor is exactly the 5,000-trajectory Lite.ScaleCUA desktop-use run. Do not attribute aliasmix counts to this donor.
alias_distinction.training: Combined Lite.OSWorld + Lite.ScaleCUA + Lite.CUAGym; README reports 10,934 exported rows, including 5,000 Lite.ScaleCUA rows.

caveats: README and remote training_config agree on 5,000 trajectories, 42,427 serialized steps, 3 epochs, 468 optimizer updates, iter_467, and 5e-6 cosine LR to 1e-6.
The README describes a seeded candidate pool replenished to 5,000 usable trajectories after filtering; the raw dataset total and rejected-row count are not documented here.
No downstream benchmark evaluation is reported in the pinned README.
No prompts, emails, credentials, or raw config were copied.

facts.filter: non-excluded trajectories with episode return > 0.5; replenish candidates until 5,000 usable trajectories
facts.full_vs_adapter: Full-parameter supervised fine-tuning; full BF16 model. No adapter-only artifact indicated.
